mathematical_scope: Exact Euclidean tetrahedral maximum and full equality locus in either congruent mirror snub cube, with parity-selected tribonacci coordinates.
scientific_limitations: Finite algebraic certificate for 10626 vertex quadruples and an exact convex-affinity extension; no near-equality stability; relevant inaccessible historic literature could in principle duplicate this result.
title: Largest inscribed tetrahedra of the snub cube
